title: Target anatomy
view: The right upper face of the skull from the front: head at the top, the patient's right on the image left.
teachingPoint: The notch sits on the superior orbital rim in line with the pupil, the supratrochlear just medial; the needle stays subcutaneous above the rim, over the notch, then redirects medially in the same plane, never toward the orbit.
claims: Right upper face of the skull from the front, patient's right on the image left (house laterality).
Supraorbital notch on the superior orbital rim on the pupil line (record subtitle).
Supratrochlear nerve exiting slightly medial to the notch (record subtitle); about 12 mm medial and its notch are standard anatomy added here.
Needle from just above the eyebrow, lateral, aimed medially; tip subcutaneous over the notch, short of the rim (record steps 3-4).
Dashed: the redirect medially in the same plane toward the bridge of the nose for the supratrochlear (record step 5).
Red dashes: the pupil line. Yellow: the supraorbital nerve's two branches and the supratrochlear nerve running up the forehead (standard anatomy, added).
Labels: Supraorbital notch, Supratrochlear nerve, Orbit.

geometry.why: supratrochlear exits medial to the notch
notch on the superior rim, above the orbit
tip above the notch, not in it
tip over the notch, about 5 mm above it
the needle does not enter the notch
the redirect stays above the rim
the redirect stays superficial to the supratrochlear exit
redirect ends over the supratrochlear exit
the supratrochlear nerve leaves through its notch
needle runs down and medially from above the brow
